blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The University of the Philippines (UP) Cebu Fighting Maroons scored twin victories in the collegiate and high school divisions of the Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation, Inc. (Cesafi) Season 26 football tournament on Sunday, November 15, at the Cebu City Sports Center (CCSC) pitch. After a one-week break, the tournament resumed with UP Cebu scoring victories in both divisions against their respective opponents. In the morning match, Qyel Ino Sollano scored UP Cebu’s lone goal just two minutes into the game, leading the Fighting Maroons to a 1-0 victory over the San Carlos School of Cebu (SCSC) Baby […]...
